bullets: ELEGANT FLORAL DESIGN: Features five sparkling crystal flower charms with marquise-cut stones arranged gracefully along a delicate gold-toned invisible chain.
BUTTERFLY ACCENT DETAILS: Each flower charm is complemented by a dainty butterfly motif, adding a whimsical and feminine touch to the necklace.
ADJUSTABLE FIT: Equipped with a secure hook-and-loop clasp with an extender link, allowing for a comfortable and customisable fit around the neckline.
VERSATILE STYLING: Pairs beautifully with both traditional ethnic wear and contemporary outfits, making it ideal for festive occasions, weddings, and everyday elegance.
GOLD-TONED FINISH: The lustrous gold-toned chain and beaded accents complement the clear crystal flowers, creating a radiant and eye-catching jewellery piece.
description: Introduce a touch of timeless elegance to your look with the MITHRAS CANADA Flowers with Butterfly Invisible Chain Necklace. This delicate yet eye-catching piece features five sparkling crystal flower charms, each adorned with marquise-cut clear stones set in a warm gold-toned finish, gracefully suspended along a sleek, barely-there invisible chain. The subtle butterfly-inspired accents at the base of each flower add a whimsical charm that makes this necklace truly unique. Secured with a classic hook-and-loop clasp with an extender for an adjustable, comfortable fit, this necklace sits beautifully at the collarbone. Whether paired with a traditional ethnic ensemble, a flowy kurta, or a contemporary outfit, this versatile piece transitions effortlessly from festive celebrations to everyday wear. It also makes a thoughtful and cherished gift for loved ones. The lightweight design ensures all-day comfort without compromising on style, making it a must-have addition to any jewellery collection.
